notes.title: CLOUD SAVING
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41070255/a44a0a1483c63df66e3743c1eb1437e5a9b8b67c.png[/img]

[h2]☁️Cloud Saving is Coming to Curse Crackers!☁️[/h2]

On August 19th, Cloud Saving will be enabled on Curse Crackers: For Whom the Belle Toils.

Once it is enabled and if you have files on two different devices, make sure to first play on the device with the data you want to keep!

If you want to keep both sets of saves, you can manually store them by copying the PS.syr files from "Users\AppData\LocalLow\Colorgrave\Curse Crackers Belle". The number in each file's name corresponds to the save slot in the game's menu.

notes.title: THE FUTURE
notes.content:
THE FUTURE

As we previously mentioned in the FAQ there will be at the very least one content update for Curse Crackers.  Since this update is intended to answer on some player feedback and areas we think we should have better thought of I wanted to communicate what we are working on.  We appreciate your patience and hope you will look forward to it sometime next year. Our content release schedule on Prodigal was very aggressive and we were unable to do any other work during those times.   Hopefully by more evenly distributing things we will both be able to release this content in a timely manner and not greatly delay what we are working on next.

Curse Crackers 1.1: Halted Dawns

-1 additional ‘super level’ unlocked in Adventure.
-1 new way to play both adventure and arcade.
-Tweaks to arcade mode.  Let’s make this thing flashy!
-Elite feats & rewards
-Belle and Chime skins
-100% completion reward
-1 new side quest
-1 new menu art as voted by the discord community
-The tower.
-At least one very secret boss fight just for you bumpkin. 
-Curses to take the challenge to the next level.

Considering:
-Additional ways to play dodgeball
-Band practice

Characters:
While we will use and include characters as we think is best for the story we want to tell there are plenty of threads we have to pull on!  That in mind we posted a character popularity poll to help give us an idea who would want to be seen the most with the additional sidequests.  If you would like to participate drop by and hit me with your results before the end of the month for your vote to be heard.  Currently the top five are:
1. Belle
2. Vivian
3. Genevive
4. Bonnie
5. Ema 

Thank you for your time and support.  We hope you are looking forward to all we have in store.

-Mhinbron

notes.title: Secret Update
notes.content:
This patch contains a number of fixes and some responses to player feedback.  The most notable of which being the bathhouse in Grevenfel.  If you would like to see your progress on the secret collectables or find hints on where the ones you have missed there is no better place to clear your head.

CHANGES
-Adjusted some secrets to be easier to find

-New character added
-Those who miss out on rescuing a certain someone in time will now get to see something special.
-Typos.

ON THE LIST
-Disable boss cutscenes in Hollow

-Some issues with instant text
-Polish dodgeball a bit
-Add run toggle option

Thanks for the love and support.  We are thrilled with how much everyone is enjoying the game so far.  Have a great weekend.
-Mhinbron

notes.title: RELEASE! (+FAQ)
notes.content:
As if from no where the game is released!  Who could have seen this coming?  We are excited to share with you the results of our hard work and hope you will have a blast exploring the world of Ledamra.  That said I wanted to address a number of questions and concerns folks might have about the game and it's future post release.

RELEASE FAQ
Is there a post-game? Yes.  There are post game quests and activities.
Are there hidden levels? There are definitely not any secret levels in Curse Crackers for Whom the Belle Toils.  Why would anyone ever hide secrets and levels?!
Are there quests? Yep!  The world of Ledamra is full of curious characters and some of them need your help.  While they may not reward you directly, sharp eyed players may find where they will be rewarded for their help.
Free content updates? At least 1 planned in the future.
Paid DLC? No.  Only free content updates.  You already paid for the game.
Key Rebinding? Maybe should there be demand.
Bugs? Please report

notes.title: Release August 31st!
notes.content:
It's been a long time coming as we work away at the game to make sure release is as clean as we can possibly manage.  It's been quite the journey taking the game from idea to reality over the last year, but we are incredibly proud of what we have accomplished. 

We are beyond excited to share the world and characters of Ledamra with you in less than a week!  See you then!
